title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy - Criminal History Considerations
requirement: Housing providers receiving DND funding/land or BPDA inclusionary units must not use a blanket denial policy for arrests or convictions and must not consider arrests without conviction, expunged or sealed convictions, juvenile records, or convictions more than five years old.
coverage_conditions: housing providers receiving Department of Neighborhood Development (DND) funding and/or land, or that have income restricted units created under the Boston Planning and Development Agency (BPDA) Inclusionary Development Policy
exemptions: Situations where there is a direct relationship between a conviction and the housing sought and/or unreasonable risk of substantial harm to the safety of others, or current criminal behavior.
interaction: Where federal or state law imposes a criminal history requirement that conflicts with this policy, the federal or state law preempts this policy.

title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy - Credit Score Prohibition
requirement: The agent agrees not to use the applicant credit score to approve or deny housing applications, though credit history may be considered in lieu of rental history only when rental history is unavailable.
coverage_conditions: housing providers receiving Department of Neighborhood Development (DND) funding and/or land, or that have income restricted units created under the Boston Planning and Development Agency (BPDA) Inclusionary Development Policy
